description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateAllowedActionAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving allowed actions for a specific recruitment candidate within a Human Resource Management system. It includes logic for role and state-based filtering of permitted workflow actions, and integrates with internal services and traits related to candidates and user roles.

classes.name: CandidateAllowedActionAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving allowed workflow actions for candidates within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve list of allowed actions for a specific candidate, filtering based on candidate state, role, and interview count.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if the current authenticated user is the hiring manager for the specified candidate vacancy.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' API method, specifically validating the candidate ID parameter.
